name: linear
description: Read, search, create, and update issues, projects, cycles, comments, labels, milestones, and initiatives in Linear through the official hosted Linear MCP server. Connects over Streamable HTTP with OAuth 2.1 by default, or via a Bearer token for headless and CI use.

interface.shortDescription: Read and write issues, projects, and cycles in Linear via the official MCP server.
interface.longDescription: The Linear skill exposes Linear's official hosted MCP server (https://mcp.linear.app/mcp) as a single Fractal toolset. It uses Streamable HTTP transport and OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration by default, with an `Authorization: Bearer` fallback (LINEAR_API_KEY or LINEAR_OAUTH_TOKEN) for headless and CI environments. The toolset surfaces the full Linear GraphQL surface — issues, projects, cycles, labels, milestones, initiatives, comments, and attachments — for read, search, create, and update workflows against a live Linear workspace.
defaultPrompt: Use the Linear skill whenever the task involves reading, searching, creating, or updating issues, projects, cycles, or comments in a Linear workspace.
Filter at the server — pass `assignee`, `state`, `team`, `label`, `project`, `cycle`, `priority`, or `query` to `list_issues` rather than fetching the full backlog.
Resolve human names to ids (list_users, list_teams, list_issue_statuses, list_labels) before calling create_issue or update_issue.
